name: Ministry of Silly Walks
description: Tasked with ensuring every corridor is traversed in the most inefficient and visually preposterous manner possible.

roles.name: Chief Silliness Officer
roles.description: Sets quarterly KPIs for knee-lift height and ankle-twist frequency.

roles.name: Gait Auditor
roles.description: Surprises teams with clipboard-in-hand walk-tests and issues citations for excessive normality.

roles.name: Stride Evangelist
roles.description: Runs noon-hour masterclasses on emerging absurd locomotion trends.

name: Department of Argumentation
description: Provides on-demand, well-structured disagreements for anyone needing a vigorous contradiction.

roles.name: Head Contradictor
roles.description: Professionally refutes every statement, including their own, for maximum dialectical agility.

roles.name: Professional Naysayer
roles.description: Offers premium ‘No it isn’t!’ packages with same-day delivery.

roles.name: Devil’s Advocate
roles.description: Raises objections nobody asked for, purely out of principle (or lack thereof).

name: Bureau of Completely Useless Products
description: Designs, prototypes, and markets items guaranteed to solve absolutely zero real-world problems.

roles.name: Chief Uselessness Engineer
roles.description: Ensures all products exceed strict non-functionality standards before launch.

roles.name: Director of Pointless Innovation
roles.description: Leads ideation sprints for concepts like inflatable dartboards and waterproof tea-bags.

name: Dead Parrot Complaint Office
description: Handles customer grievances with unwavering insistence that every defective item is merely ‘resting.’

roles.name: Senior Parrot Reanimator
roles.description: Delivers theatrical denial demonstrations, occasionally involving puppetry and coconut shells.

roles.name: Customer Inconvenience Coordinator
roles.description: Crafts labyrinthine phone trees to ensure complaints remain delightfully unresolved.

roles.name: Denial Specialist
roles.description: Polishes the official ‘not dead yet’ narrative across all communication channels.

name: Department of Shrubbery Procurement
description: Maintains strategic alliances with the Knights Who Say ‘Ni!’ to secure aesthetically pleasing shrubberies.

roles.name: Grand Shrubbery Overseer
roles.description: Defines corporate shrub-height regulations and negotiates bulk topiary deals.

roles.name: Royal Bush Trimmer
roles.description: Keeps every hedge impeccably coiffed to medieval-court standards.

roles.name: Knight Liaison
roles.description: Translates executive memos into acceptable offerings for shrub-obsessed knights.
